chunks: The obligations of salat (prayer) are seven: the time, purification, attention, the qibla, bowing, prostration, and supplication.

key_terms.الدُّعَاءُ: du'a, supplication within the prayer context
key_terms.الرُّكُوعُ: ruku', the bowing posture in prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.الطَّهُورُ: taharah (ritual purity), including purification required for prayer
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةُ: the direction of the Ka'bah faced in prayer
key_terms.الْوَقْتُ: the prescribed time for performing the prayer

ai.seo_question: What are the seven obligations of salat (prayer) in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith lists seven foundational obligations of salat (prayer). It emphasizes that valid prayer depends on its appointed time, taharah (ritual purity), proper orientation, core bodily acts, and du'a (supplication).
